import atexit
import json
from flask import Flask, jsonify, request, Response
import time
import socket
import threading
import shutil
import subprocess
from urllib.error import URLError
from urllib.parse import urlsplit
from urllib.request import urlopen

app = Flask(__name__, static_folder='.', static_url_path='')
datos_actuales = {
    'esp': '{"x": 0, "y": 0, "z": 0}',
    'mobile': '{"gyro": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "z": 0}}',
}
ultima_lectura = {'esp': None, 'mobile': None}
ngrok_process = None
ngrok_status = 'not-started'


def get_lan_ip():
    address_probe = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
    try:
        address_probe.connect(('8.8.8.8', 80))
        return address_probe.getsockname()[0]
    except OSError:
        return '127.0.0.1'
    finally:
        address_probe.close()


def get_ngrok_url():
    try:
        with urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:4040/api/tunnels', timeout=0.5) as response:
            tunnels = json.load(response).get('tunnels', [])
    except (OSError, URLError, ValueError):
        return None

    matching_urls = []
    for tunnel in tunnels:
        address = tunnel.get('config', {}).get('addr', '')
        try:
            parsed_address = urlsplit(address if '://' in address else f'http://{address}')
            public_url = tunnel.get('public_url', '')
            if parsed_address.port == 8080 and public_url.startswith(('https://', 'http://')):
                matching_urls.append(public_url)
        except ValueError:
            continue

    return next((url for url in matching_urls if url.startswith('https://')), None) or next(iter(matching_urls), None)


def start_ngrok_tunnel():
    global ngrok_process, ngrok_status

    if get_ngrok_url():
        ngrok_status = 'ready'
        print("Túnel ngrok existente detectado.")
        return

    ngrok_path = shutil.which('ngrok')
    if not ngrok_path:
        ngrok_status = 'unavailable'
        print("ngrok no está instalado o no está en PATH; el QR HTTPS no estará disponible.")
        return

    try:
        ngrok_process = subprocess.Popen(
            [ngrok_path, 'http', '8080'],
            stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
        )
    except OSError as error:
        ngrok_status = 'failed'
        print(f"No se pudo iniciar ngrok: {error}")
        return

    ngrok_status = 'starting'
    for _ in range(30):
        if ngrok_process.poll() is not None:
            ngrok_status = 'failed'
            print("ngrok terminó antes de crear el túnel. Comprueba que la cuenta esté autenticada.")
            return
        if get_ngrok_url():
            ngrok_status = 'ready'
            print("Túnel HTTPS de ngrok listo.")
            return
        time.sleep(0.5)

    print("ngrok sigue iniciando; la página detectará la URL HTTPS en cuanto esté disponible.")


def stop_ngrok_tunnel():
    if ngrok_process is None or ngrok_process.poll() is not None:
        return
    ngrok_process.terminate()
    try:
        ngrok_process.wait(timeout=5)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        ngrok_process.kill()
        ngrok_process.wait(timeout=5)


atexit.register(stop_ngrok_tunnel)


def escuchar_udp_descubrimiento():
    puerto_udp = 8888
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM) as sock:
        sock.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_BROADCAST, 1)
        sock.bind(("0.0.0.0", puerto_udp))
        print(f"Escuchando gritos del ESP8266 en el puerto UDP {puerto_udp}...")

        while True:
            data, addr = sock.recvfrom(1024)
            mensaje = data.decode('utf-8').strip()

            if mensaje == "GORRITO_BUSCANDO_JUEGO":
                print(f"¡Gorrito encontrado en la IP {addr[0]}! Enviando respuesta...")
                sock.sendto(b"JUEGO_AQUI", addr)

@app.route('/')
def index():
    return app.send_static_file('index.html')

@app.route('/mando')
def mando():
    return app.send_static_file('mando.html')

@app.route('/connection-info')
def connection_info():
    ngrok_url = get_ngrok_url()
    if ngrok_url:
        return jsonify(mobileUrl=f'{ngrok_url}/mando', connectionType='ngrok', ngrokStatus='ready')
    return jsonify(
        mobileUrl=f'http://{get_lan_ip()}:8080/mando',
        connectionType='lan',
        ngrokStatus=ngrok_status,
    )

@app.route('/sensor-status')
def sensor_status():
    source = request.args.get('source', 'esp')
    if source not in ultima_lectura:
        return "Fuente no válida", 400

    last_reading = ultima_lectura[source]
    age = time.monotonic() - last_reading if last_reading is not None else None
    return jsonify(connected=age is not None and age <= 2, ageSeconds=age)

@app.route('/datos', methods=['POST'])
def recibir_datos():
    source = request.args.get('source', 'esp')
    if source not in datos_actuales:
        return "Fuente no válida", 400

    try:
        payload = json.loads(request.get_data(as_text=True))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return "El cuerpo debe ser JSON válido", 400
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        return "El cuerpo debe ser un objeto JSON", 400

    datos_actuales[source] = json.dumps(payload, separators=(',', ':'))
    ultima_lectura[source] = time.monotonic()
    return "OK", 200

@app.route('/stream')
def stream():
    source = request.args.get('source', 'esp')
    if source not in datos_actuales:
        return "Fuente no válida", 400

    def generar_eventos():
        while True:
            yield f"data: {datos_actuales[source]}\n\n"
            time.sleep(0.05)

    return Response(generar_eventos(), mimetype='text/event-stream')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    hilo_udp = threading.Thread(target=escuchar_udp_descubrimiento, daemon=True)
    hilo_udp.start()
    hilo_ngrok = threading.Thread(target=start_ngrok_tunnel, daemon=True)
    hilo_ngrok.start()
    local_ip = get_lan_ip()
    print("Servidor listo (ESP + móvil).")
    print("Juego en este ordenador: http://localhost:8080")
    print(f"Mando móvil: http://{local_ip}:8080/mando")
    app.run(host='0.0.0.0', port=8080, threaded=True)

  <script type="module">

    import {
      GestureRecognizer,
      FilesetResolver
    } from "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@mediapipe/tasks-vision@0.10.3";

    let gestureRecognizer;
    let ultimoGesto = "None";
    let ultimaVezVideo = -1;
    let cameraStream = null;
    const ESP_FALLBACK_TIMEOUT_MS = 5000;
    const loadingMessage = document.querySelector("#loadingMessage");
    const startChecksButton = document.querySelector("#startChecksButton");
    let resolveFirstGestureFrame;
    let rejectFirstGestureFrame;
    function setLoadingCheck(name, state, message) {
      const row = document.querySelector(`[data-loading-check="${name}"]`);
      row.dataset.state = state;
      row.querySelector("strong").textContent = message;

      const progressStep = document.querySelector(`[data-progress-step="${name}"]`);
      progressStep.dataset.state = state;
      const cameraReady = document.querySelector('[data-loading-check="camera"]').dataset.state === "passed";
      const gyroReady = document.querySelector('[data-loading-check="gyro"]').dataset.state === "passed";
      document.querySelector("#loadingProgress").setAttribute("aria-valuenow", String((Number(cameraReady) + Number(gyroReady)) * 50));
    }

    async function iniciarMediaPipe() {
      cameraStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ video: true });
      console.log("Cargando modelo de gestos...");
      const vision = await FilesetResolver.forVisionTasks(
        "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@mediapipe/tasks-vision@0.10.3/wasm"
      );

      gestureRecognizer = await GestureRecognizer.createFromOptions(
        vision,
        {
          baseOptions: {
            modelAssetPath:
              "https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/gesture_recognizer/gesture_recognizer/float16/1/gesture_recognizer.task",
            delegate: "GPU"
          },
          runningMode: "VIDEO",
          numHands: 1
        }
      );
      console.log("Modelo de gestos cargado. Encendiendo cámara...");
      await encenderCamara(cameraStream);
    }

    async function encenderCamara(stream) {
      const video = document.getElementById("webcam");
      video.srcObject = stream;
      await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        video.addEventListener("loadeddata", resolve, { once: true });
        video.addEventListener("error", () => reject(new Error("No se pudo iniciar el video de la cámara.")), { once: true });
      });
      await video.play();
      const firstFrame = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        resolveFirstGestureFrame = resolve;
        rejectFirstGestureFrame = reject;
        window.setTimeout(() => reject(new Error("El modelo de gestos no respondió a la cámara.")), 10000);
      });
      predecirBucle(video);
      await firstFrame;
    }

    function actualizarVistaGesto(gesture) {
      const status = document.querySelector("#gestureRecognitionStatus");
      const gestureName = gestureDisplayNames[gesture];
      status.textContent = gestureName
        ? `Gesto detectado: ${gestureName}`
        : "No hay gesto detectado.";

      document.querySelectorAll("[data-gesture-card]").forEach(card => {
        const active = card.dataset.gestureCard === gesture;
        card.dataset.active = String(active);
        if (active) card.setAttribute("aria-current", "true");
        else card.removeAttribute("aria-current");
      });
    }

    function predecirBucle(video) {
      const tiempoActual = performance.now();

      if (video.currentTime !== ultimaVezVideo) {
        ultimaVezVideo = video.currentTime;

        let resultados;
        try {
          resultados = gestureRecognizer.recognizeForVideo(video, tiempoActual);
          if (resolveFirstGestureFrame) {
            resolveFirstGestureFrame();
            resolveFirstGestureFrame = null;
            rejectFirstGestureFrame = null;
          }
        } catch (error) {
          if (rejectFirstGestureFrame) {
            rejectFirstGestureFrame(error);
            rejectFirstGestureFrame = null;
            resolveFirstGestureFrame = null;
            return;
          }
          console.error("Error al analizar un gesto:", error);
          requestAnimationFrame(() => predecirBucle(video));
          return;
        }

        if (resultados.gestures.length > 0) {
          const gestoActual = resultados.gestures[0][0].categoryName;

          if (gestoActual !== ultimoGesto) {
            console.log("Gesto detectado:", gestoActual);
            actualizarVistaGesto(gestoActual);
            ultimoGesto = gestoActual;
            ejecutarComandoGesto(gestoActual);
          }
        } else {
          if (ultimoGesto !== "None") {
            console.log("Gesto detectado: None (Sin mano)");
            actualizarVistaGesto("None");
            ultimoGesto = "None";
          }
        }
      }

      requestAnimationFrame(() => predecirBucle(video));
    }

    function ejecutarComandoGesto(gesto) {
      if (!gameMenu.hidden) {
        if (gesto === "Pointing_Up") selectMenuOption("play", gesto);
        else if (gesto === "Victory") selectMenuOption("tutorial", gesto);
        return;
      }
      if (!window.tetrisGameStarted) return;

      let keyToSimulate = null;

      switch (gesto) {
        case "Pointing_Up":
          keyToSimulate = "y";
          break;
        case "Victory":
          keyToSimulate = " ";
          break;
        case "Open_Palm":
          keyToSimulate = "c";
          break;
      }

      if (keyToSimulate) {
        console.log(
          `Gesto: "${gesto}" → ${keyToSimulate === " " ? "Space" : keyToSimulate}`
        );

        document.dispatchEvent(
          new KeyboardEvent("keydown", {
            key: keyToSimulate,
            code: keyToSimulate === " " ? "Space" : keyToSimulate,
            bubbles: true
          })
        );
      }
      if (!document.querySelector("#tutorialScreen").hidden) {
        recordTutorialGesture(gesto);
      }
    }

    const loadingScreen = document.querySelector("#loadingScreen");
    const gameMenu = document.querySelector("#gameMenu");
    const tutorialScreen = document.querySelector("#tutorialScreen");
    const tutorialTitle = document.querySelector("#tutorialTitle");
    const tutorialStepText = document.querySelector("#tutorialStepText");
    const tutorialProgress = document.querySelector("#tutorialProgress");
    const tutorialGestureImage = document.querySelector("#tutorialGestureImage");
    const mobileFallback = document.querySelector("#mobileFallback");
    let cameraReady = false;
    let gyroDetected = false;
    let gamePrepared = window.tetrisGamePrepared === true;
    let mobileSelected = false;
    let espFallbackTimer;
    let tutorialMode = null;
    let tutorialStep = 0;
    let previousCheatMode = false;
    const gestureDisplayNames = {
      Pointing_Up: "Apuntando",
      Open_Palm: "Palma abierta",
      Thumb_Down: "Pulgar abajo",
      Thumb_Up: "Pulgar arriba",
      Closed_Fist: "Mano cerrada",
      Victory: "Victoria",
      ILoveYou: "I love you"
    };
    const gyroTutorialSteps = [
      { key: "ArrowRight", title: "Inclina a la derecha", prompt: "Inclina el giroscopio a la derecha una vez. Después vuelve al centro." },
      { key: "ArrowLeft", title: "Inclina a la izquierda", prompt: "Inclina el giroscopio a la izquierda una vez. Después vuelve al centro." },
      { key: "ArrowUp", title: "Inclina hacia arriba", prompt: "Inclina el giroscopio hacia arriba una vez. Después vuelve al centro." },
      { key: "ArrowDown", title: "Inclina hacia abajo", prompt: "Inclina el giroscopio hacia abajo una vez. Después vuelve al centro." }
    ];
    const gestureTutorialSteps = [
      { name: "Pointing_Up", image: "apuntando.png", imageAlt: "Gesto de apuntar con el dedo índice", prompt: "Levanta solo el dedo índice para rotar la pieza sobre el eje Y." },
      { name: "Victory", image: "victoria.png", imageAlt: "Gesto de victoria con dos dedos", prompt: "Haz el gesto de Victoria para hacer bajar rápidamente la pieza." },
      { name: "Open_Palm", image: "palma.png", imageAlt: "Gesto de palma abierta", prompt: "Muestra la palma para alternar entre las dos vistas de cámara." }
    ];
    const tutorialTotalSteps = gyroTutorialSteps.length + gestureTutorialSteps.length;

    function showMobileFallback() {
      if (gyroDetected || mobileSelected || document.querySelector("#gyroSource").value !== "esp") return;
      mobileFallback.hidden = false;
      setLoadingCheck("gyro", "waiting", "Sin conexión · obligatorio");
      loadingMessage.textContent = "El giroscopio es obligatorio para jugar. Conecta el móvil o espera a que responda el ESP.";
    }

    function startGameWhenReady() {
      if (!cameraReady || !gyroDetected || !gamePrepared || !gameMenu.hidden) return;
      loadingScreen.hidden = true;
      gameMenu.hidden = false;
    }

    function launchGame() {
      const finishingTutorial = tutorialMode !== null;
      tutorialScreen.hidden = true;
      gameMenu.hidden = true;
      document.body.classList.remove("tutorial-active");
      document.querySelector("#accept").checked = previousCheatMode;
      tutorialMode = null;
      window.tetrisTutorialMode = false;
      if (finishingTutorial) window.dispatchEvent(new Event("tetris-tutorial-finished"));
      window.tetrisSensorsReady = true;
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event("tetris-sensors-ready"));
    }

    function selectMenuOption(option, triggeringGesture = null) {
      if (gameMenu.hidden) return;
      gameMenu.hidden = true;
      if (option === "tutorial") {
        previousCheatMode = document.querySelector("#accept").checked;
        document.querySelector("#accept").checked = true;
        ultimoGesto = triggeringGesture ?? "None";
        window.tetrisTutorialMode = true;
        tutorialScreen.hidden = false;
        document.body.classList.add("tutorial-active");
        tutorialMode = gyroDetected ? "gyro" : "gesture";
        tutorialStep = 0;
        updateTutorialStep();
        window.tetrisSensorsReady = true;
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event("tetris-sensors-ready"));
        return;
      }
      window.tetrisFreshStartRequested = true;
      window.tetrisTutorialMode = false;
      launchGame();
    }

    function updateTutorialStep() {
      const stepNumber = tutorialStep + 1;
      document.querySelector("#tutorialStepNumber").textContent =
        `${String(stepNumber).padStart(2, "0")} / ${
          tutorialMode === "gyro" ? tutorialTotalSteps : gestureTutorialSteps.length
        }`;

      if (tutorialMode === "gyro") {
        const step = gyroTutorialSteps[tutorialStep];
        tutorialGestureImage.hidden = true;
        tutorialTitle.textContent = step.title;
        tutorialStepText.textContent = step.prompt;
        tutorialProgress.textContent = "Mira cómo responde la pieza en el tablero.";
      } else if (tutorialMode === "gesture") {
        const step = gestureTutorialSteps[tutorialStep];
        tutorialGestureImage.src = step.image;
        tutorialGestureImage.alt = step.imageAlt;
        tutorialGestureImage.hidden = false;
        tutorialTitle.textContent = `Gesto ${tutorialStep + 1} de ${gestureTutorialSteps.length}`;
        tutorialStepText.textContent = step.prompt;
        tutorialProgress.textContent = "Espera a que se detecte el gesto; retira la mano entre intentos.";
      }
    }

    function advanceTutorialStep() {
      tutorialStep++;
      if (tutorialMode === "gyro" && tutorialStep === gyroTutorialSteps.length) {
        tutorialMode = "gesture";
        tutorialStep = 0;
      } else if (tutorialMode === "gesture" && tutorialStep === gestureTutorialSteps.length) {
        tutorialTitle.textContent = "¡Tutorial terminado!";
        tutorialStepText.textContent = "Ya probaste los gestos para rotar y bajar la pieza. La partida comienza ahora.";
        tutorialProgress.textContent = "";
        tutorialMode = "complete";
        window.setTimeout(launchGame, 1400);
        return;
      }
      updateTutorialStep();
    }

    function recordTutorialGyroDirection(direction) {
      if (tutorialMode !== "gyro" || !window.tetrisGameStarted) return;
      const expected = gyroTutorialSteps[tutorialStep];
      if (direction !== expected.key) {
        tutorialProgress.textContent = `Detecté ${direction.replace("Arrow", "").toLowerCase()}. Prueba ahora: ${expected.title.toLowerCase()}.`;
        return;
      }
      tutorialProgress.textContent = "¡Bien! La pieza respondió al giroscopio.";
      advanceTutorialStep();
    }
    window.handleTutorialGyroDirection = recordTutorialGyroDirection;

    function recordTutorialGesture(gesture) {
      if (tutorialMode !== "gesture") return;
      const expected = gestureTutorialSteps[tutorialStep];
      if (gesture !== expected.name) {
        tutorialProgress.textContent = `Detecté ${gesture}. Ahora prueba: ${expected.name}.`;
        return;
      }
      tutorialProgress.textContent = `¡${gesture} detectado! La pieza giró.`;
      advanceTutorialStep();
    }

    async function monitorGyroscope() {
      const startedAt = Date.now();
      while (!gyroDetected) {
        const source = document.querySelector("#gyroSource").value;
        try {
          const response = await fetch(`/sensor-status?source=${encodeURIComponent(source)}`, { cache: "no-store" });
          if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`El servidor respondió ${response.status}.`);
          const { connected } = await response.json();
          if (connected) {
            gyroDetected = true;
            window.clearTimeout(espFallbackTimer);
            mobileFallback.hidden = true;
            setLoadingCheck("gyro", "passed", `${source === "esp" ? "ESP" : "Móvil"} responde`);
            loadingMessage.textContent = "Giroscopio verificado.";
            startGameWhenReady();
            return;
          }

          if (source === "mobile") {
            setLoadingCheck("gyro", "active", "Esperando al móvil");
          } else if (Date.now() - startedAt >= ESP_FALLBACK_TIMEOUT_MS) {
            showMobileFallback();
          } else {
            const seconds = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((ESP_FALLBACK_TIMEOUT_MS - (Date.now() - startedAt)) / 1000));
            setLoadingCheck("gyro", "active", `Buscando ESP · ${seconds} s`);
          }
        } catch (error) {
          console.error("No se pudo comprobar el giroscopio:", error);
          if (source === "esp" && Date.now() - startedAt >= ESP_FALLBACK_TIMEOUT_MS) {
            showMobileFallback();
          } else {
            setLoadingCheck("gyro", "error", "Error al consultar el servidor");
            loadingMessage.textContent = `No se pudo comprobar el giroscopio: ${error.message}`;
          }
        }
        await new Promise(resolve => window.setTimeout(resolve, 500));
      }
    }

    document.querySelector("#useMobileButton").addEventListener("click", () => {
      mobileSelected = true;
      window.clearTimeout(espFallbackTimer);
      const sourceSelect = document.querySelector("#gyroSource");
      sourceSelect.value = "mobile";
      sourceSelect.dispatchEvent(new Event("change"));
      document.querySelector("#mobileFallbackTitle").textContent = "Conecta el mando móvil";
      document.querySelector("#mobileFallback").querySelector("p").textContent =
        "Abre el mando en el teléfono y pulsa “Iniciar sensor”. Esta pantalla seguirá esperando sus lecturas.";
      document.querySelector("#mobileInstructions").hidden = false;
      document.querySelector("#useMobileButton").hidden = true;
      document.querySelector("#keepEspButton").hidden = true;
      setLoadingCheck("gyro", "active", "Esperando al móvil");
      loadingMessage.textContent = "Esperando la respuesta del giroscopio del móvil…";
    });

    document.querySelector("#keepEspButton").addEventListener("click", () => {
      document.querySelector("#keepEspButton").hidden = true;
      loadingMessage.textContent = "Sigo esperando el giroscopio. También puedes cambiar al móvil.";
    });

    document.querySelector("#playMenuButton").addEventListener("click", () => selectMenuOption("play"));
    document.querySelector("#tutorialMenuButton").addEventListener("click", () => selectMenuOption("tutorial"));
    document.querySelector("#tutorialSkipButton").addEventListener("click", launchGame);

    startChecksButton.addEventListener("click", async () => {
      if (startChecksButton.textContent === "Recargar página") {
        window.location.reload();
        return;
      }
      startChecksButton.disabled = true;
      startChecksButton.hidden = true;
      loadingMessage.textContent = "Cargando el modelo de gestos y buscando el giroscopio…";
      setLoadingCheck("camera", "active", "Cargando modelo y cámara");
      setLoadingCheck("gyro", "active", "Buscando ESP");
      espFallbackTimer = window.setTimeout(showMobileFallback, ESP_FALLBACK_TIMEOUT_MS);
      monitorGyroscope();

      try {
        await iniciarMediaPipe();
        setLoadingCheck("camera", "passed", "Listo");
      } catch (error) {
        console.error("Falló la comprobación de la cámara:", error);
        setLoadingCheck("camera", "error", error.message || "No disponible");
        cameraStream?.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop());
        cameraStream = null;
        document.querySelector("#webcam").srcObject = null;
        loadingMessage.textContent = "No se pudo verificar la cámara. Revisa los permisos y recarga la página para intentarlo de nuevo.";
        startChecksButton.textContent = "Recargar página";
        startChecksButton.hidden = false;
        return;
      }

      cameraReady = true;
      loadingMessage.textContent = "Cámara y gestos responden. Esperando la conexión del giroscopio…";
      startGameWhenReady();
    });

    window.addEventListener("tetris-game-prepared", () => {
      gamePrepared = true;
      startGameWhenReady();
    });
    window.addEventListener("tetris-started", () => {
      ultimoGesto = "None";
      actualizarVistaGesto("None");
      if (tutorialMode === "gyro") {
        tutorialProgress.textContent = "Tablero listo. Inclina el giroscopio y mira cómo responde la pieza.";
      }
    });
    startChecksButton.click();
  </script>


<script>
  const gyroSource = document.querySelector("#gyroSource");
  const sensorConnectionStatus = document.querySelector("#sensorConnectionStatus");
  let sensorEvents;
  let currentDirection = null;

  function simulateTetrisKey(key) {
    document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown", {
      key,
      code: key,
      bubbles: true
    }));
    window.handleTutorialGyroDirection?.(key);
  }

  function findAxis(reading, axis) {
    if (Number.isFinite(reading?.[axis])) return reading[axis];
    if (Number.isFinite(reading?.gyro?.[axis])) return reading.gyro[axis];
    return undefined;
  }

  function connectSensor(source) {
    if (sensorEvents) sensorEvents.close();
    currentDirection = null;
    sensorConnectionStatus.textContent = `Conectando al ${source === "esp" ? "ESP" : "móvil"}…`;
    sensorEvents = new EventSource(`/stream?source=${encodeURIComponent(source)}`);

    sensorEvents.onopen = () => {
      sensorConnectionStatus.textContent = `Escuchando ${source === "esp" ? "ESP" : "móvil"}.`;
    };

    sensorEvents.onmessage = event => {
      let reading;
      try {
        reading = JSON.parse(event.data);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error("El servidor envió datos de sensor no válidos:", error);
        sensorConnectionStatus.textContent = "Error: datos del sensor no válidos.";
        return;
      }

      const x = findAxis(reading, "x");
      const y = findAxis(reading, "y");
      if (!Number.isFinite(x) || !Number.isFinite(y)) return;

      if (source === "esp") {
        const movementThreshold = 0.35;
        const centerThreshold = 0.15;
        let direction = null;
        if (x > movementThreshold && currentDirection !== "ArrowRight") direction = "ArrowLeft";
        else if (x < -movementThreshold && currentDirection !== "ArrowLeft") direction = "ArrowRight";
        else if (y > movementThreshold && currentDirection !== "ArrowDown") direction = "ArrowDown";
        else if (y < -movementThreshold && currentDirection !== "ArrowUp") direction = "ArrowUp";
        else if (Math.abs(x) < centerThreshold && Math.abs(y) < centerThreshold) currentDirection = null;

        if (direction) {
          simulateTetrisKey(direction);
          currentDirection = direction;
        }
        return;
      }

      const horizontal = y;
      const vertical = x;
      const movementThreshold = 12;
      let direction = null;
      if (Math.max(Math.abs(horizontal), Math.abs(vertical)) >= movementThreshold) {
        if (Math.abs(horizontal) > Math.abs(vertical)) {
          direction = horizontal > 0 ? "ArrowRight" : "ArrowLeft";
        } else {
          direction = vertical > 0 ? "ArrowDown" : "ArrowUp";
        }
      }

      if (!direction) {
        const activeAxis = currentDirection === "ArrowLeft" || currentDirection === "ArrowRight"
          ? horizontal
          : vertical;
        if (Math.abs(activeAxis) < 8) currentDirection = null;
      } else if (direction !== currentDirection) {
        simulateTetrisKey(direction);
        currentDirection = direction;
      }
    };

    sensorEvents.onerror = () => {
      sensorConnectionStatus.textContent = `Esperando datos del ${source === "esp" ? "ESP" : "móvil"}…`;
    };
  }

  gyroSource.value = "esp";
  gyroSource.addEventListener("change", () => connectSensor(gyroSource.value));
  connectSensor(gyroSource.value);

  let renderedMobileUrl = null;
  let lastNgrokStatus = null;
  const qrElements = [
    [document.querySelector("#mobileControllerQr"), document.querySelector("#controllerQrStatus")],
    [document.querySelector("#loadingMobileQr"), document.querySelector("#loadingQrStatus")]
  ];

  const updateMobileQr = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/connection-info", { cache: "no-store" });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`El servidor respondió ${response.status}.`);
      const { mobileUrl, connectionType, ngrokStatus } = await response.json();

      if (connectionType !== "ngrok") {
        const message = ngrokStatus === "unavailable"
          ? "ngrok no está instalado. Instálalo y reinicia el servidor para habilitar el QR HTTPS."
          : ngrokStatus === "failed"
            ? "ngrok no pudo iniciar. Revisa que tu cuenta esté autenticada y reinicia el servidor."
            : "Iniciando el túnel HTTPS de ngrok…";
        qrElements.forEach(([element, statusElement]) => {
          if (renderedMobileUrl !== null || element.childElementCount > 0) element.replaceChildren();
          element.dataset.placeholder = message;
          statusElement.textContent = message;
        });
        renderedMobileUrl = null;
        if (lastNgrokStatus !== ngrokStatus) {
          sensorConnectionStatus.textContent = message;
          lastNgrokStatus = ngrokStatus;
        }
        return;
      }

      if (typeof QRCode !== "function") {
        throw new Error("No se pudo cargar el generador de códigos QR.");
      }

      if (renderedMobileUrl !== mobileUrl) {
        qrElements.forEach(([element, statusElement]) => {
          element.replaceChildren();
          new QRCode(element, {
            text: mobileUrl,
            width: 192,
            height: 192,
            colorDark: "#080d18",
            colorLight: "#ffffff",
            correctLevel: QRCode.CorrectLevel.M
          });
          element.dataset.placeholder = "";
          statusElement.textContent = "Escanea para abrir mando.html por HTTPS";
        });
        renderedMobileUrl = mobileUrl;
      }
      if (lastNgrokStatus !== "ready") {
        sensorConnectionStatus.textContent = "Puente HTTPS de ngrok listo para el móvil.";
        lastNgrokStatus = "ready";
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("No se pudo generar el QR del mando móvil:", error);
      qrElements.forEach(([element, statusElement]) => {
        element.replaceChildren();
        element.dataset.placeholder = "QR no disponible";
        statusElement.textContent = error.message;
      });
    }
  };

  updateMobileQr();
  window.setInterval(updateMobileQr, 3000);
</script>
</body>

</html>

==> ./js/VAOManager.js <==
const VAO_CUBE = 0;
const VAO_CYLINDER = 1;
const VAO_GRID = 2;
const VAO_BOUNDINGBOX = 3;
const VAO_AMONGUS = 4;
const VAO_PLANE = 5;
const VAO_FLOOR_GRID = 6;

class VAOManager {
    #vaos = new Map()
    #currentTetrisShapeVAO = -1;

    /* -------- Add a new VAO to the manager -------- */

    addVAO(vao, vaoId) {
        this.#vaos.set(vaoId, vao);
    }

    /* -------- Get VAO by ID ------- */

    getVAO(vaoId) {
        if (vaoId < 0)
            return this.#vaos.get(this.#currentTetrisShapeVAO);

        return this.#vaos.get(vaoId);
    }

    /* -------- Initialize all the VAOs -------- */

    initializeVAOs(gl, shader) {
        this.#vaos.forEach(vao => vao.initBuffersAndVAO(gl, shader));
    }

    /* -------- Set the current VAO used for tetris shapes  ------- */

    setTetrisShapeVAO(vaoId) {
        this.#currentTetrisShapeVAO = vaoId;
    }
}

export {
    VAOManager,
    VAO_CUBE,
    VAO_CYLINDER,
    VAO_GRID,
    VAO_BOUNDINGBOX,
    VAO_AMONGUS,
    VAO_PLANE,
    VAO_FLOOR_GRID
}

==> ./js/MouseInteraction.js <==
import * as glm from './gl-matrix/index.js';

const MOUSE_SENSITIVITY = 5; // Constant to represent the sensitivity of the mouse input

class MouseInteraction {
    #initialMousePosition = null;
    #mouseDown;
    #mouseUp;
    #mouseMove;
    #mouseOut;

    /* -------- Register mouse events for camera movement -------- */

    registerEvents(canvas, camera) {
        this.#mouseDown = (event) => this.#handleMouseDown(event);
        this.#mouseUp = (event) => this.#handleMouseUp(event, canvas, camera);
        this.#mouseMove = (event) => this.#handleMouseMove(event, canvas, camera);
        this.#mouseOut = (event) => this.#handleMouseUp(event, canvas, camera);

        canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', this.#mouseDown);
        canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', this.#mouseUp);
        canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', this.#mouseMove);
        canvas.addEventListener('mouseout', this.#mouseOut);
    }

    /* -------- Delete keybord events -------- */

    deleteEvents(canvas, camera) {
        canvas.removeEventListener('mousedown', this.#mouseDown);
        canvas.removeEventListener('mouseup', this.#mouseUp);
        canvas.removeEventListener('mousemove', this.#mouseMove);
        canvas.removeEventListener('mouseout', this.#mouseOut);
    }

    /* -------- Handle mouse input -------- */

    #handleMouseDown(event) {
        // Store the initial mouse position
        this.#initialMousePosition = glm.vec2.fromValues(event.x, event.y);
    }

    #handleMouseUp(event, canvas, camera) {
        // Save the mouse transformation
        if (this.#initialMousePosition != null) {
            const currentMousePosition = glm.vec2.fromValues(event.x, event.y);
            const mouseDelta = this.#calculateMouseDelta(canvas, currentMousePosition);
            camera.rotateCamera('y', mouseDelta[0]);
        }

        // Reset the initial mouse position
        this.#initialMousePosition = null;
    }

    #handleMouseMove(event, canvas, camera) {
        // Only process if we have initialMousePosition (a mouse button is pressed)
        if (this.#initialMousePosition === null) {
            return;
        }

        const currentMousePosition = glm.vec2.fromValues(event.x, event.y);
        const mouseDelta = this.#calculateMouseDelta(canvas, currentMousePosition);

        // Translate the camera based on the mouse delta
        camera.rotateCameraForMouse(mouseDelta[0]);
        
    }

    #calculateMouseDelta(canvas, currentMousePosition) {
        const mouseDelta = glm.vec2.create();

        // Calculate the difference between the current and initial mouse positions
        glm.vec2.sub(mouseDelta, this.#initialMousePosition, currentMousePosition);

        // Normalize the mouse delta based on the canvas size and sensitivity
        glm.vec2.divide(mouseDelta, mouseDelta, glm.vec2.fromValues(canvas.width, canvas.height));
        glm.vec2.scale(mouseDelta, mouseDelta, MOUSE_SENSITIVITY);

        return mouseDelta;
    }
}

export { MouseInteraction }


==> ./js/server.js <==
const express = require('express');
const app = express();

// Permite procesar los datos JSON que envía la placa ESP
app.use(express.json());

// Sirve tu archivo index.html y tus carpetas de assets
app.use(express.static(__dirname));

let clientesConectados = [];

// 1. La placa ESP envía los datos aquí (POST)
app.post('/datos', (req, res) => {
    console.log("📡 Datos del MCU recibidos:", req.body); // Imprime en la terminal del Mac
    
    // Reenvía los datos al HTML al instante
    clientesConectados.forEach(cliente => {
        cliente.res.write(`data: ${JSON.stringify(req.body)}\n\n`);
    });
    
    res.sendStatus(200);
});

// 2. Tu HTML se conecta aquí para escuchar los datos (GET)
app.get('/stream', (req, res) => {
    res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'text/event-stream');
    res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'no-cache');
    res.setHeader('Connection', 'keep-alive');
    
    clientesConectados.push({ res });
    
    req.on('close', () => {
        clientesConectados = clientesConectados.filter(c => c.res !== res);
    });
});

==> ./js/grid.js <==
import { Shape } from './Shape.js';
import { VAO } from './VAO.js';
import * as vaos from './VAOManager.js';

const cellSize = 0.15;
const halfWidth = (5 * cellSize) / 2;
const bottom = -0.9;
const top = 0.9;
const height = top - bottom;
const heightDivisions = Math.round(height / cellSize);

const createGridGeometry = () => {
    const vertices = [];
    const indices = [];
    const floorVertices = [];
    const floorIndices = [];
    const gridCoordinates = (min, max, divisions) =>
        Array.from({ length: divisions + 1 }, (_, index) => min + index * cellSize);
    const xCoordinates = gridCoordinates(-halfWidth, halfWidth, 5);
    const zCoordinates = gridCoordinates(-halfWidth, halfWidth, 5);
    const yCoordinates = gridCoordinates(bottom, top, heightDivisions);

    const addLine = (targetVertices, targetIndices, start, end) => {
        const firstIndex = targetVertices.length / 3;
        targetVertices.push(...start, ...end);
        targetIndices.push(firstIndex, firstIndex + 1);
    };

    for (const y of yCoordinates) {
        const isFloor = y === bottom;
        const targetVertices = isFloor ? floorVertices : vertices;
        const targetIndices = isFloor ? floorIndices : indices;
        const lineY = isFloor ? bottom + 0.002 : y;
        for (const z of zCoordinates) {
            addLine(targetVertices, targetIndices, [-halfWidth, lineY, z], [halfWidth, lineY, z]);
        }
        for (const x of xCoordinates) {
            addLine(targetVertices, targetIndices, [x, lineY, -halfWidth], [x, lineY, halfWidth]);
        }
    }

    for (const x of xCoordinates) {
        for (const z of zCoordinates) {
            addLine(vertices, indices, [x, bottom, z], [x, top, z]);
        }
    }

    return { vertices, indices, floorVertices, floorIndices };
};

const createGrid = (vaoManager) => {
    const { vertices, indices, floorVertices, floorIndices } = createGridGeometry();
    const gridIndex = vaos.VAO_GRID;
    const floorIndex = vaos.VAO_FLOOR_GRID;
    const vao = new VAO(vertices, null, indices, null);
    const floorVao = new VAO(floorVertices, null, floorIndices, null);

    vaoManager.addVAO(vao, gridIndex);
    vaoManager.addVAO(floorVao, floorIndex);
    return {
        lines: new Shape(vaoManager, gridIndex),
        floor: new Shape(vaoManager, floorIndex)
    };
};

export { createGrid };

==> ./js/ShapeGenerator.js <==
import * as glm from './gl-matrix/index.js'
import { Shape } from './Shape.js';
import { VAO } from './VAO.js';
import { TetrisShape } from './TetrisShape.js';
import * as vaos from './VAOManager.js';

const cubeLength = 0.15;

class ShapeGenerator {
    createVAOFromOBJFile(objFile) {
        return new VAO(
            objFile.vertices,
            objFile.normals,
            objFile.indices,
            objFile.textures
        );
    }

    createFlatShape(vaoManager, cells) {
        this.cubes = [];

        const maxX = Math.max(...cells.map(([x]) => x));
        const maxZ = Math.max(...cells.map(([, z]) => z));

        for (const [x, z] of cells) {
            const shape = new Shape(vaoManager);
            glm.mat4.translate(shape.translateToBuildShapeMatrix, shape.translateToBuildShapeMatrix, [x * cubeLength, 0, z * cubeLength]);
            this.cubes.push(shape);
        }

        const tetrisShape = new TetrisShape(this.cubes);
        tetrisShape.translate([
            -Math.floor(maxX / 2) * cubeLength,
            cubeLength * 6.5,
            -Math.floor(maxZ / 2) * cubeLength
        ]);
        return tetrisShape;
    }

    createShapeMonomino(vaoManager) {
        return this.createFlatShape(vaoManager, [[0, 0]]);
    }

    createShapeDomino(vaoManager) {
        return this.createFlatShape(vaoManager, [[0, 0], [1, 0]]);
    }

    createShapeTrominoStraight(vaoManager) {
        return this.createFlatShape(vaoManager, [[0, 0], [1, 0], [2, 0]]);
    }

    createShapeTrominoL(vaoManager) {
        return this.createFlatShape(vaoManager, [[0, 0], [1, 0], [0, 1]]);
    }

    createShapeTetrominoI(vaoManager) {
        return this.createFlatShape(vaoManager, [[0, 0], [1, 0], [2, 0], [3, 0]]);
    }

    createShapeTetrominoO(vaoManager) {
        return this.createFlatShape(vaoManager, [[0, 0], [1, 0], [0, 1], [1, 1]]);
    }

    createShapeTetrominoT(vaoManager) {
        return this.createFlatShape(vaoManager, [[0, 0], [1, 0], [2, 0], [1, 1]]);
    }

    createShapeTetrominoL(vaoManager) {
        return this.createFlatShape(vaoManager, [[0, 0], [1, 0], [2, 0], [2, 1]]);
    }

    createShapeTetrominoJ(vaoManager) {
        return this.createFlatShape(vaoManager, [[0, 0], [1, 0], [2, 0], [0, 1]]);
    }

    createShapeTetrominoS(vaoManager) {
        return this.createFlatShape(vaoManager, [[0, 0], [1, 0], [1, 1], [2, 1]]);
    }

    createShapeTetrominoZ(vaoManager) {
        return this.createFlatShape(vaoManager, [[0, 1], [1, 1], [1, 0], [2, 0]]);
    }

    generateGroundPlane(vaoManager) {
        const vertices = [
            -0.375, -0.9, -0.375,
            -0.375, -0.9, 0.375,
            0.375, -0.9, -0.375,
            0.375, -0.9, 0.375
        ];

        const indices = [
            0, 1, 2,
            1, 3, 2
        ];

        const normals = [
            0, 1, 0,   // normal 0
            0, 1, 0,   // normal 1
            0, 1, 0,   // normal 2
            0, 1, 0    // normal 3
        ];

        const index = vaos.VAO_PLANE;
        const vao = new VAO(
            vertices,
            normals,
            indices,
            null
        );

        vaoManager.addVAO(vao, index);
        return new Shape(vaoManager, index);
}
}
export { ShapeGenerator };

==> ./js/shaderUtils.js <==
/* -------- Creating a shader to display -------- */

const createShader = (gl, type, source) => {
    const shader = gl.createShader(type);
    gl.shaderSource(shader, source);
    gl.compileShader(shader);

    // If the shader compiles return the shader
    const success = gl.getShaderParameter(shader, gl.COMPILE_STATUS);
    if (success) {
        return shader;
    }

    console.log(gl.getShaderInfoLog(shader));

    // Delete the shader if it doesn't compile
    gl.deleteShader(shader);
}

/* --------  Creating a shader program object to store the combined shader -------- */

const createProgram = (gl, vertexShader, fragmentShader) => {
    const program = gl.createProgram();
    gl.attachShader(program, vertexShader);
    gl.attachShader(program, fragmentShader);
    gl.linkProgram(program);

    const success = gl.getProgramParameter(program, gl.LINK_STATUS);
    if (success) {
        return program;
    }

    console.log(gl.getShaderInfoLog(program));

    // Delete the program if it doesn't compile
    gl.deleteProgram(program);
}

export { createShader, createProgram };

import * as glm from './gl-matrix/index.js';
import { round } from './gl-matrix/vec3.js';
import { Shape } from './Shape.js';

const KEYBOARD_SENSITIVITY = 0.05; // Constant to represent the sensitivity of the keyboard input
const ROTATION_ANGLE = Math.PI / 180 * 90; // Rotate shape 90 degrees per key press
const CAMERA_ROTATION_ANGLE = Math.PI / 180 * 5; // Rotate camer 5 degrees per key press
const TRANSLATION_FACTOR = 0.15; // One Unit (cube length)

class KeyboardInteraction {
    #selectedShader = null;
    #isPhongShader = false;
    #isDrawCubes = true;
    #isAmogusMode = false;
    #handler;
    #clonedCubies = [];

    /* -------- Register keybord events for movement -------- */

    registerEvents(camera, gameLogic, shaders, vaoManager) {
        this.gridEnabled = false;
        this.#selectedShader = shaders.get("sBaseGS");
        this.#isPhongShader = false;
        this.#isDrawCubes = true;
        this.#isAmogusMode = false;
        this.#handler = (event) => this.#handleKeyDown(event, camera, gameLogic, shaders, vaoManager);
        document.addEventListener('keydown', this.#handler);
    }

    /* -------- Delete keybord events -------- */

    deleteEvents(camera, gameLogic, shaders, vaoManager) {
        this.gridEnabled = false;
        this.#selectedShader = shaders.get("sBaseGS");
        document.removeEventListener('keydown', this.#handler);
    }
    
    /* -------- Select shaders -------- */

    #selectShader(shaders) {
        this.#isPhongShader = !this.#isPhongShader;
        if(!this.#isPhongShader) {
            this.#selectedShader = shaders.get("sBaseGS");
        } else {      
            this.#selectedShader = shaders.get("sBasePS");
        }    
    }

    /* -------- Return current selected shader -------- */

    selectedShader() {
        return this.#selectedShader;
    }

    /* -------- Handle keyboard input -------- */

    #handleKeyDown(event, camera, gameLogic, shaders, vaoManager) {

        switch(event.key) {
            /* -------- Translate shape -------- */
            case 'd':
            case 'ArrowRight':
                if(isCheatMode(gameLogic)) {
                    this.#clonedCubies = gameLogic.getTetraCubes().clone();
                    this.#clonedCubies.translate([TRANSLATION_FACTOR, 0, 0]);

                    if(gameLogic.checkTransform(this.#clonedCubies)) {
                        gameLogic.getTetraCubes().translate([TRANSLATION_FACTOR, 0, 0]);
                    }
                }
                break;
            case 'a':
            case 'ArrowLeft':
                if(isCheatMode(gameLogic)) {
                    this.#clonedCubies = gameLogic.getTetraCubes().clone();
                    this.#clonedCubies.translate([-TRANSLATION_FACTOR, 0, 0]);

                    if(gameLogic.checkTransform(this.#clonedCubies)) {
                        gameLogic.getTetraCubes().translate([-TRANSLATION_FACTOR, 0, 0]);
                    }
                }
                break;
            case 'w':
            case 'ArrowUp':
                if(isCheatMode(gameLogic)) {
                    this.#clonedCubies = gameLogic.getTetraCubes().clone();
                    this.#clonedCubies.translate([0, 0, -TRANSLATION_FACTOR]);

                    if(gameLogic.checkTransform(this.#clonedCubies)) {
                        gameLogic.getTetraCubes().translate([0, 0, -TRANSLATION_FACTOR]);
                    }
                }
                break;
            case 's':
            case 'ArrowDown':
                if(isCheatMode(gameLogic)) {
                    this.#clonedCubies = gameLogic.getTetraCubes().clone();
                    this.#clonedCubies.translate([0, 0, TRANSLATION_FACTOR]);

                    if(gameLogic.checkTransform(this.#clonedCubies)) {
                        gameLogic.getTetraCubes().translate([0, 0, TRANSLATION_FACTOR]);
                    }
                }
                break;

            /* -------- Rotate shape -------- */
            case 'x':
                if(isCheatMode(gameLogic)) {
                    gameLogic.tryRotate(gameLogic.getTetraCubes(), 'x', ROTATION_ANGLE);
                }
                break;
            case 'X':
                if(isCheatMode(gameLogic)) {
                    gameLogic.tryRotate(gameLogic.getTetraCubes(), 'x', -ROTATION_ANGLE);
                }
                break;
            case 'y':
                if(isCheatMode(gameLogic)) {
                    gameLogic.tryRotate(gameLogic.getTetraCubes(), 'y', ROTATION_ANGLE);
                }
                break;
            case 'Y':
                if(isCheatMode(gameLogic)) {
                    gameLogic.tryRotate(gameLogic.getTetraCubes(), 'y', -ROTATION_ANGLE);
                }
                break;
            case 'z':
                if(isCheatMode(gameLogic)) {
                    gameLogic.tryRotate(gameLogic.getTetraCubes(), 'z', ROTATION_ANGLE);
                }
                break;
            case 'Z':
                if(isCheatMode(gameLogic)) {
                    gameLogic.tryRotate(gameLogic.getTetraCubes(), 'z', -ROTATION_ANGLE);
                }
                break;

            /* -------- (Un)pause the game (stop/restart gravity) -------- */
            case 'p':
                if(!gameLogic.isGameOver) {
                    gameLogic.isGamePaused = !gameLogic.isGamePaused;

                    if(gameLogic.isGamePaused) {
                        gameLogic.deltaTime = performance.now() - gameLogic.last;
                    }
                    else {
                        gameLogic.last = performance.now() - gameLogic.deltaTime;
                    }
                }
                break;

            /* -------- Drop shape fast and release control -------- */
            case ' ':
                event.preventDefault();
                if(!gameLogic.isGamePaused && !gameLogic.isGameOver) {
                    gameLogic.setGravityFactor(-0.075 / 4);
                }
                break;

            /* -------- Rotate camera -------- */
            case 'j':
                camera.rotateCamera('y', CAMERA_ROTATION_ANGLE);
                break;
            case 'l':
                camera.rotateCamera('y', -CAMERA_ROTATION_ANGLE);
                break;
            case 'i':
                camera.rotateCamera('x', CAMERA_ROTATION_ANGLE);
                break;
            case 'k':
                camera.rotateCamera('x', -CAMERA_ROTATION_ANGLE);
                break;
            case 'u':
                camera.rotateCamera('z', CAMERA_ROTATION_ANGLE);
                break;
            case 'o':
                camera.rotateCamera('z', -CAMERA_ROTATION_ANGLE);
                break;

            /* -------- Zoom camera -------- */
            case '+':
                camera.zoom(glm.vec3.fromValues(1 + KEYBOARD_SENSITIVITY, 1 + KEYBOARD_SENSITIVITY, 1 + KEYBOARD_SENSITIVITY));
                break;
            case '-':
                camera.zoom(glm.vec3.fromValues(1 - KEYBOARD_SENSITIVITY, 1 - KEYBOARD_SENSITIVITY, 1 - KEYBOARD_SENSITIVITY));
                break;

            /* -------- Switch view -------- */
            case 'v':
                camera.switchView(camera.getIsProjectionOrthogonal());
                break;
            case 'c':
                camera.toggleTwoViews();
                break;

            /* -------- Switch shader -------- */
            case 'f':
                this.#selectShader(shaders);
                console.log(this.#selectedShader);
                break;

            /* -------- Show underlying grid -------- */
            case 'g':
                this.gridEnabled = !this.gridEnabled;
                break;

            /* -------- Render objects as cylinders -------- */
            case 'b':
                this.#isDrawCubes = !this.#isDrawCubes;
                if(this.#isDrawCubes) {
                    vaoManager.setTetrisShapeVAO(0);
                } else {
                    vaoManager.setTetrisShapeVAO(1);
                }
                break;

            /* -------- Render objects as amogus -------- */
            case 'n':
                this.#isAmogusMode = !this.#isAmogusMode;
                if(this.#isAmogusMode) {
                    vaoManager.setTetrisShapeVAO(4);
                } else {
                    vaoManager.setTetrisShapeVAO(0);
                }
                break;
                /* -------- Change camera views -------- */
            case '1':
                // Vista 2D (desde arriba hacia abajo)
                if(typeof camera.setTopDownView === 'function') {
                    camera.setTopDownView();
                } else {
                    console.log("Falta implementar setTopDownView() en Camera.js");
                }
                break;
            case '2':
                // Vista por defecto
                if(typeof camera.setDefaultView === 'function') {
                    camera.setDefaultView();
                } else {
                    console.log("Falta implementar setDefaultView() en Camera.js");
                }
                break;
            case '3':
                // Vista vertical
                if(typeof camera.setVerticalView === 'function') {
                    camera.setVerticalView();
                } else {
                    console.log("Falta implementar setVerticalView() en Camera.js");
                }
                break;
        }
    }
}

==> ./js/Shader.js <==
import * as glm from './gl-matrix/index.js';
import { createShader, createProgram } from './shaderUtils.js';

class Shader {
    // Fields
    vertName = '';
    fragName = '';
    program = -1;
    locACoord = -1;
    locANormal = -1;
    locATexture = -1;
    locUTransform = -1;
    locPTransform = -1;
    locVTransform = -1;
    locNTransform = -1;
    locLDirection = -1;
    locAProduct = -1;
    locDProduct = -1;
    locSProduct = -1;
    locShininess = -1;
    locShapeColor = -1;
    locLVPTransform = -1;
    locIsTransparent = -1;

    constructor(vertName, fragName) {
        this.vertName = vertName;
        this.fragName = fragName;
    }

    // Load and compile the shader program from the vertex and fragment shader source code
    async loadAndCompile(gl) {

        /* -------- Prepare shaders -------- */

        const vertShaderSrc = await fetch(`shaders/${this.vertName}.vert`)
            .then(response => response.text());
        const vertShader = createShader(
            gl,
            gl.VERTEX_SHADER,
            vertShaderSrc
        );

        const fragShaderSrc = await fetch(`shaders/${this.fragName}.frag`)
            .then(response => response.text());
        const fragShader = createShader(
            gl,
            gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER,
            fragShaderSrc
        );

        /* -------- Create program -------- */

        this.program = createProgram(
            gl,
            vertShader,
            fragShader
        );

        /* -------- Get the attribute for the shader program -------- */

        this.locACoord= gl.getAttribLocation(
            this.program,
            "a_coords"
        );

        this.locANormal = gl.getAttribLocation(
            this.program,
            "a_normal"
        );

        this.locATexture = gl.getAttribLocation(
            this.program,
            "a_texcoord"
        )
        
        /* -------- Get uniform locations for the shader program -------- */

        this.locPTransform = gl.getUniformLocation(
            this.program,
            "u_projection"
        );

        this.locUTransform = gl.getUniformLocation(
            this.program,
            "u_transform"
        );

        this.locVTransform = gl.getUniformLocation(
            this.program,
            "u_view"
        );

        this.locNTransform = gl.getUniformLocation(
            this.program,
            "u_normal"
        );

        this.locLDirection = gl.getUniformLocation(
            this.program,
            "u_shadowLightDirection"
        );

        this.locAProduct = gl.getUniformLocation(
            this.program,
            "u_ambientProduct"
        );

        this.locDProduct = gl.getUniformLocation(
            this.program,
            "u_diffuseProduct"
        );

        this.locSProduct = gl.getUniformLocation(
            this.program,
            "u_specularProduct"
        );

        this.locShininess = gl.getUniformLocation(
            this.program,
            "u_shininess"
        );

        this.locShapeColor = gl.getUniformLocation(
            this.program,
            "u_color"
        );

        this.locLVPTransform = gl.getUniformLocation(
            this.program,
            "u_lightViewProj"
        );

         this.shadowMapLocation = gl.getUniformLocation(
             this.program,
             "u_shadowMap"
         );

         this.locIsTransparent = gl.getUniformLocation(
             this.program,
             "u_isTransparent"
        );
     }

    /* -------- Bind shader program for rendering -------- */

    bind(gl) {
        gl.useProgram(this.program);
    }

    /* -------- Set projection & view matrices as uniforms for shader program -------- */

    uniformMatrices(gl, projectionMatrix, viewMatrix) {
        gl.uniformMatrix4fv(
            this.locPTransform,
            false,
            projectionMatrix
        );

        gl.uniformMatrix4fv(
            this.locVTransform,
            false,
            viewMatrix
        );
    }

    /* -------- Set color uniform for shader program -------- */

    setColorUniform(gl, color, texture) {
        if(texture !== null) {
            gl.uniform4fv(
                this.locShapeColor,
                glm.vec4.fromValues(0., 0., 0., 0.)
            );
        } else {
            gl.uniform4fv(
                this.locShapeColor,
                color
            );
        }
    }

    /* -------- Set shading uniforms for shader program -------- */

    setShadingUniforms(gl, ambientProduct, diffuseProduct, specularProduct, shininess) {
        gl.uniform3fv(
            this.locAProduct,
            ambientProduct
        );

        gl.uniform3fv(
            this.locDProduct,
            diffuseProduct
        );

        gl.uniform3fv(
            this.locSProduct,
            specularProduct
        );

        gl.uniform1f(
            this.locShininess,
            shininess
        );
    }

    /* -------- Set lighting for shader program -------- */

    lightingUniforms(gl, viewMatrix) {

        const resultVec4 = glm.vec4.fromValues(0, 10, 0, 0.0);
        glm.vec4.transformMat4(resultVec4, resultVec4, viewMatrix);

        const lightDirection = glm.vec3.fromValues(resultVec4[0], resultVec4[1], resultVec4[2]);

        gl.uniform3fv(
            this.locLDirection,
            lightDirection
        );
    }

    /* -------- Set shadowing for shader program -------- */

    shadowingUniforms(gl, lightMatrix, shadowMap) {
        gl.uniformMatrix4fv(
            this.locLVPTransform,
            false,
            lightMatrix
        );

        gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE1);
        gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, shadowMap);

        gl.uniform1i(
            this.shadowMapLocation,
            1
        );
    }

    /* -------- Set plane uniform -------- */

    setTransparency(gl, isTransparent) {
        gl.uniform2fv(
            this.locIsTransparent,
            isTransparent
        );
    }

    /* -------- Update shading values for shader program -------- */

    updateShadingCoefficients(gl, ambientProduct, diffuseProduct, specularProduct) {
        gl.uniform3fv(
            this.locAProduct,
            ambientProduct
        );

        gl.uniform3fv(
            this.locDProduct,
            diffuseProduct
        );

        gl.uniform3fv(
            this.locSProduct,
            specularProduct
        );
    }
}

export { Shader }
